胡九郎的手僵在半空，脸上的喜悦，瞬间凝固，眼底闪过一丝错愕与不解。

“杨童，你……你怎么了？”

杨童闭上眼，深吸一口气，语气平淡得没有一丝情绪。

“我没事，你没事了就好，省得我白费力气。”

胡九郎心头一沉，像是被什么东西狠狠刺了一下。

“杨童，你到底怎么了？是不是哪里不舒服？还是……”

杨童打断他的话，语气依旧冷漠。

“我救你只是因为你是被我牵连的。若不是我一时大意触犯了白仙，你也不会替我挡下那一击，更不会昏迷不醒。一开始我就不该让你牵扯到这些事当中，我这么做只是为了弥补我的过错，没有其他任何意思，你不要多想。”

胡九郎还想追问，还想弄清楚到底是怎么回事，可就在这时，房门被轻轻推开，林佳走了进来，看到房间里僵持的气氛，还有胡九郎眼中的不解与痛苦，连忙上前，轻轻拉住胡九郎的胳膊，对着他使了个眼色。

“胡兄，你刚醒，身体还很虚弱，别在这里打扰杨童休息了，我们先出去，让她好好养身体。”

林佳的声音很轻，带着一丝劝解。

胡九郎还想说什么，却被林佳用力拉了一下，眼神里满是示意，让他不要冲动。

胡九郎看着床上神色冷漠的杨童，心中满是不甘与不解，可他也知道，此刻再追问下去，也只会让杨童更加抗拒，只能深深看了她一眼，轻声道：

“好，我不打扰你休息，你好好养身体，我会一直守在外面。”

胡九郎被林佳拉着，缓缓走出房间，轻轻带上了房门。

胡九郎就忍不住问道：

“杨童到底怎么了？她为什么会对我这么冷漠？她明明为了救我差点付出性命，怎么醒来之后，就像变了一个人一样？”

林佳拉着他走到院子里，找了个石凳坐下，叹了口气，看着胡九郎憔悴又不解的模样，轻声道：

“胡兄，你别太着急，也别多想。杨童不是对你冷漠，她只是性格本就冷淡，不擅长表达自己的心意。”

胡九郎摇了摇头。

“不是的，她以前不是这样的，就算高冷，也不会对我说这些话。她为了我连命都不要了，怎么可能只是为了弥补过错？”

Hu Jiulang's hands froze in mid-air, the joy on his face froze in an instant, and a trace of astonishment and confusion flashed in his eyes.

"Yang Tong, you...what's wrong with you?"

Yang Tong closed his eyes, took a deep breath, and spoke in a calm tone without any emotion.

"I'm fine. It's good if you're fine, so I don't have to waste my time."

Hu Jiulang's heart sank, as if he had been stabbed hard by something.

"Yang Tong, what's wrong with you? Are you feeling uncomfortable somewhere? Or..."

Yang Tong interrupted him, his tone still cold.

"I only saved you because you were implicated by me. If I hadn't accidentally offended Bai Xian, you wouldn't have blocked the blow for me, let alone been unconscious. I shouldn't have let you get involved in these things in the first place. I only did this to make up for my mistakes. There is no other meaning. Don't think too much about it."

Hu Jiulang still wanted to ask more questions and find out what was going on, but at this moment, the door was gently pushed open, and Lin Jia walked in. Seeing the deadlocked atmosphere in the room, as well as the confusion and pain in Hu Jiulang's eyes, she quickly stepped forward, gently pulled Hu Jiulang's arm, and winked at him.

"Brother Hu, you just woke up and are still very weak. Don't disturb Yang Tong's rest here. Let's go out first and let her take good care of herself."

Lin Jia's voice was very soft, with a hint of persuasion.

Hu Jiulang wanted to say something else, but he was pulled hard by Lin Jia. His eyes were full of signs, telling him not to be impulsive.

Hu Jiulang looked at the indifferent Yang Tong on the bed, his heart full of unwillingness and confusion, but he also knew that if he continued to ask questions at this moment, it would only make Yang Tong more resistant. He could only look at her deeply and said softly:

"Okay, I won't disturb your rest. You can take good care of yourself. I will always stay outside."

Hu Jiulang was pulled by Lin Jia, slowly walked out of the room, and gently closed the door.

Hu Jiulang couldn't help but ask:

"What happened to Yang Tong? Why was she so indifferent to me? She almost gave up her life to save me. Why did she feel like a different person when she woke up?"

Lin Jia pulled him to the yard, found a stone bench and sat down, sighed, looked at Hu Jiulang's haggard and puzzled look, and said softly:

"Brother Hu, don't be too anxious, and don't think too much. It's not that Yang Tong is indifferent to you, she just has a cold personality and is not good at expressing her feelings."

Hu Jiulang shook his head.

"No, she wasn't like this before. Even if she was cold, she wouldn't say these words to me. She even risked her life for me. How could she just make up for her mistakes?"
